title: Convention interfaces / app-controller-action-parameter
meaning: IControllerModelConvention targets ControllerModel and controller-level metadata.
IActionModelConvention targets ActionModel and action-level metadata.
IParameterModelConvention targets ParameterModel and parameter-level binding/metadata.
Razor Pages has analogous page model conventions.
boundary_notes: R01 explains when/why to use conventions.
R03/R04 explain the model classes and their properties.
